name: The Dino of My Dreams!
source:
The Dino of My Dreams is a cute,  light-hearted dating sim where you meet and date three different dinosaurs!

Meet the dinos!

[From [url=https://thekittycatlane.itch.io/the-dino-of-my-dreams]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我的梦想恐龙是一款可爱、轻松的约会模拟游戏，你可以在其中遇见并约会三种不同的恐龙！

认识恐龙！

[来自[url=https://thekittycatlane.itch.io/the-dino-of-my-dreams]Itch.io[/url]]
